# E0211: a minor version rejects a field its predecessor declares

A minor version accepts every instance of its predecessor. Removing a field the
predecessor declares rejects every instance that has it. The position is the
predecessor's declaration, since the new schema has nothing to point at.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				b: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0211]: b in schema 0.1 is declared in the prior schema and not accepted by the new one
 --> lineage.cue:7:5
  |
7 |                 b: int
  |                 ^
  |
  = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule field-removed)
  = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
